name: pedometer_denied_no_app
_description: Without the owner foregrounding the app, the maximum reachable score when pedometer is denied is 35 (unlocked+bonus) + 25 (charger_disconnect) = 60, which never reaches confirm=70. The day cannot confirm via unlock+charger alone.

events._comment: 05:50 LA = 12:50 UTC. Before window. gate=closed. pedometer=denied. charging, unlocked=false.

06:05 LA = 13:05 UTC. In window. silent_push. Pedometer=denied. prev=event0(charging, unlocked=false). Still on charger; owner picked up the phone and unlocked it. unlocked: reweighted, no bonus (prev.is_unlocked=false) -> base_pts=35-10=25, cap=35, pts=25. charger_disconnect: prev=charging, curr=charging -> false -> 0. foreground: silent_push -> 0. steps/walking/steps_window skipped (pedometer unavailable). Total=25. score=25<confirm=70 -> consecutive_high=0 -> decision=low.

06:10 LA = 13:10 UTC. In window. silent_push. Gap=5min. prev=event1(charging, unlocked=true). Owner unplugged the phone but did NOT open the app. unlocked: reweighted, prev.is_unlocked=true, gap=5min<=12 -> bonus applies -> pts=reweight_value=35, cap=35. charger_disconnect: prev=charging, curr=unplugged -> true; reweighted -> pts=25, cap=25. foreground: silent_push -> 0. Total=35+25=60. score=60<confirm=70 -> consecutive_high=0 -> decision=low. This is the MAXIMUM score reachable without foreground (pedometer denied): 35+25=60 < 70 means the day can never confirm via unlock+charger alone.
